messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — Severity: P1 — OpalTech (dedicated pool: eu-west-1) — Observed: sustained p95 latency > 2.5s for 7m, customer-facing errors increasing. Pager: oncall-sre

oncall-sre (Ken): Picking this up. Initial ask: is this tenant-only or pool-wide?

sre-evan: Looks tenant-heavy. Top traces show long model load times from opaltech-tenant.

eng-runtime-maya: Confirming: their traffic spike has many long sequences; we've hit a KV cache miss storm. Model kernel hot-path shows heavy re-compiles.

csm-jordan: OpalTech CSM on call, saying customer is seeing "slow app responses" across EU region and is asking for ETA.

ops-lead-rita: Short term: can we throttle their burst or route to warm spare region? Need mitigation within 10m.

sre-evan: Recommend: 1) Apply tenant-level rate limit 2) Evict tenant to warm spare 3) Increase pool capacity — doing 1 now.

sre-evan: Running command: `redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant opaltech --qps 20` — applied, monitoring.

oncall-sre (Ken): Applied, metrics: p95 down slightly but errors still up. Recommending eviction if not improving.

eng-runtime-maya: Preparing eviction plan: `redwoodctl tenant evacuate --tenant opaltech --target warm-spare-eu1 --grace 30s` will move KV caches, may spike CPU.

ops-lead-rita: Approve evacuation. Notify CSM and post rollback plan.

csm-jordan: Notified customer that we're initiating traffic shaping + migration. Telling them ETA ~5-8m.

infra-tilly: Autoscale triggered extra nodes, but warm-spare has lower capacity — may need manual burst.

sre-evan: Starting evacuation now.

inc-bot: ACTION — eviction started by eng-runtime-maya @ 5189992330

sre-evan: Evacuation logs: `evacuate: started`, `streaming shards` — progress 40%

eng-runtime-maya: Evacuation hit a KV miss reconciliation bug; pausing migration to avoid cache corruption. Rolling back migration and will fallback to only throttling + manual capacity add.

oncall-sre (Ken): Rollback noted. Cancelling evac; proceeding to scale up. `redwoodctl pool scale --pool opaltech-dedicated --add-nodes 4 --type g4dn` — issuing now.

infra-tilly: Scale started, ETA ~3m.

sre-evan: Also enabling aggressive batching for opaltech routes: `feature-flag set opaltech.batch_aggressive=true` — reduces per-token cost, may slightly increase tail latency but helps throughput.

ops-lead-rita: Any change in external errors? csm?

csm-jordan: Customer reports latency decreased to "noticeable but acceptable", wants to stay informed.

inc-bot: METRICS UPDATE @ 5189992550 — p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.4s after throttle+scale, error rate down 75% :thumbsup: 

eng-runtime-maya: Follow-up: need a postmortem runbook entry — KV cache reconciliation under heavy tenant eviction path. Assigning to eng-runtime.

oncall-sre (Ken): I'll remain on call for next 30m to watch for regression. Assigning post-incident owner: eng-runtime-maya.

ops-lead-rita: Next steps: 1) schedule dedicated capacity review with OpalTech 2) add eviction safe-checks 3) improve autoscale headroom.

csm-jordan: Customer is pleased with fast response. They asked for an RCA and timeline for a permanent fix.

eng-runtime-maya: Will draft RCA, include mitigation options: safe eviction, smarter KV warmers, tenant-level pre-warming.

sre-evan: Closing action items in incident tracker — will update with timeline. Thanks team :trophy: 

oncall-sre (Ken): Incident resolved for now. Closing war room in 30m unless new alerts."
